newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Blanco says Bancomext funds underused.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Blanco says Bancomext funds underused.

text.p: Mexico's foreign trade development bank Bancomext in 1996 lent less than 50 percent of its available funds due to a lack of demand from commercial banks, Trade Minister Herminio Blanco said on Monday.
"The underuse of Bancomext resources was basically due to the drop in credits from commercial banks to small-sized firms," he said during a ceremony to announce the Trade Ministry's 1997 work plan.

Speaking in the presence of President Ernesto Zedillo, he said last year commercial banks only channelled $6.316 billion from Bancomext, 48.4 percent of the amount it has earmarked for export promotion.

Banks have been less willing to lend since they were plunged into crisis in 1995 by unpaid debts in the aftermath of Mexico's peso crisis. Small exporters, meanwhile, say they are starved of start-up capital.
